brief:
Canada's foreign minister Melanie Joly warned Canadian companies and entities of legal and financial risks from conducting business with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem, according to Shehab Wire. The advisory flags potential exposure to lawsuits and regulatory consequences stemming from commercial transactions involving settlements that Canada and other nations consider unlawful under international law.

The warning underscores Ottawa's longstanding position that Israeli settlements violate international legal standards and obstruct efforts toward resolving the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Canadian businesses engaging in settlement-related commerce face potential liability in domestic and international courts, as well as sanctions and compliance violations tied to doing business in occupied territory.
